baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusivity construction around words 3-5 is followed by the first-person delivery verb at word 6 and the passive commission at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause separates custody of knowledge from execution of a commission. Knowledge remains located with God, while the speaker's bounded task is to make the entrusted message reach its audience.

activation_trace.role: Contributes cognition disclosed to a knower; here it names the knowledge whose custody is distinguished from the speaker's task.
Contributes nearness and presence at a possessor; here it locates knowledge with God rather than in the envoy's independent control.
Contributes the delivery of a message; here it defines the speaker's positive and limited responsibility.
Contributes a carried message and its envoy; here it marks the delivered content as commissioned rather than self-authored.

changed_reading.before: The speaker says that God knows and that he passes on a warning.
changed_reading.after: The sentence establishes an agency boundary: comprehensive knowledge remains with God, while the speaker owns only the faithful delivery of what was entrusted to him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person perception at word 11 takes the audience as object and is completed by a collective predicate at words 12-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Perception functions as diagnosis. The audience is not merely missing a fact; lack of recognition and rash disturbance have become an observable, ongoing collective mode of conduct.

activation_trace.role: Contributes perception by eye or insight; here it frames the closing description as an asserted observation.
Contributes a human collective; here it makes the diagnosed failure social rather than merely individual.
Contributes absence or distortion of knowledge; here it identifies the epistemic component of the observed condition.
Contributes rashness and loss of composure; here it turns ignorance from a passive deficit into enacted conduct.

changed_reading.before: He calls them an ignorant people.
changed_reading.after: He reports an observed collective condition in which deficient recognition repeatedly issues as rash action, not simply a shortage of information.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3, 6, 8, and 13 can be read together through branches of marking, reaching, dispatch, and unmarked terrain.
baseline_models.mechanism: A wayfinding model joins the focus roots: knowledge supplies a distinguishing mark, dispatch releases it, delivery brings it to an endpoint, and ignorance remains terrain without usable signs.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a visible mark that distinguishes and guides; here it figures knowledge as an orienting landmark.
Contributes arrival at a limit or destination; here it gives delivery a route and endpoint.
Contributes release and dispatch into motion; here it supplies the route's point of departure.
Contributes an unknown place lacking marks or guidance; here it renders ignorance as failed orientation despite a delivered landmark.

changed_reading.before: The message communicates information to people who lack it.
changed_reading.after: The message is also an orienting mark sent along a route to make the way navigable, while their ignorance is persistence in an unmarked mode after the landmark has arrived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collective noun at word 12 and the ongoing ignorance verb at word 13 activate opposed images of upright stability and agitation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The social collective can faintly retain the root's posture of standing straight, while ignorance supplies movement after stillness and rash instability. The speaker thus sees a group failing to hold an upright cognitive posture.

activation_trace.role: Contributes straightness, balance, and uprightness; here it supplies the collective posture that is failing.
Contributes agitation that disturbs prior stillness; here it gives the collective failure a dynamic, destabilized form.
Contributes lightness of judgment and disturbed temperament; here it links instability to imprudent action.

changed_reading.before: The collective label simply identifies the people being rebuked.
changed_reading.after: The label also permits a dynamic reading: this is a collective presently unable to stand in stable judgment, shaken into rashness rather than fixed forever in an identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier context turns the baseline role distinction into a transmission chain: a well-formed book is brought down from God, the envoy disclaims independent knowledge, follows hidden communication, and serves as messenger and warner.

activation_trace.role: Contributes disclosed cognition; here it is the guarded source content in the chain.
Contributes message-delivery; here it is the human-facing terminal action in the chain.
Contributes causing something to descend and arrive; here it supplies movement from the divine source toward recipients.
Contributes ordered writing and the written object; here it gives the transmitted content a stable form.
Contributes knowledge that reaches a sound judgment; here it characterizes the source competence behind the transmission.
Contributes messenger and carried message; here it places the speaker inside a prior line of commissioned carriers.
Contributes knowing by informed awareness; its negation here narrows the envoy's independent epistemic reach.
Contributes following behind another; here it makes the envoy responsive to prior guidance rather than originator of it.
Contributes knowledge cast through a hidden channel; here it supplies the upstream input that the envoy follows.
Contributes warning that awakens caution; here it specifies the practical aim of delivery.

structural_cues: 46:2 places descent and a written object from God before the later human acts of speaking.
46:9 coordinates denial of independent knowing, exclusive following, hidden communication, and warning in one role statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, a written object, non-knowing, following, hidden communication, messengerhood, and warning. I infer a directed source-to-carrier-to-audience chain and assign custody to the source and delivery to the carrier. A live alternative is that these are parallel role descriptions rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: The focus alone distinguishes God's knowledge from the speaker's delivery.
changed_reading.after: The distinction becomes an explicit transmission architecture: the speaker receives and follows an upstream communication, then faithfully exposes its warning without claiming the source's total knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated disclosure does not cure the audience because recognition is socially defended against: clear signs are reclassified as deception, testimony is met with self-magnification, and prior social rank is used to divert the claim from truth.

activation_trace.role: Contributes failed or distorted knowledge; here it is the outcome that the context gives a social mechanism.
Contributes rash, unsettled conduct; here it permits the defensive labels and status moves to count as ignorance enacted.
Contributes meaning disclosed by speech or sign; here it establishes that the rejected material is presented as intelligible evidence.
Contributes blocking or covering truth; here it makes nonrecognition an active occlusion rather than neutral absence.
Contributes diversion through deception; here it supplies the relabeling that neutralizes a clear sign.
Contributes testimony grounded in knowledge; here it adds an external route to recognition that is nevertheless resisted.
Contributes self-greatness and pride; here it supplies a social motive for refusing the testimony.
Contributes precedence and competition; here it turns who arrived first into a false test of what is good.
Contributes falsehood diverted away from truth; here it names the endpoint of the status-preserving reclassification.

structural_cues: 46:7 places clear recitation immediately before the audience's deception label.
46:10-11 sequence testimony, self-magnification, a precedence argument, and a falsehood label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear signs, a deception label, informed testimony, pride, social precedence, and a falsehood label. I infer that status defense causally organizes the misreading and therefore revises ignorance into motivated nonrecognition. A live alternative is that the objections are separate reactions rather than one recurring social strategy.

changed_reading.before: The people do not know what the speaker knows.
changed_reading.after: Their ignorance is a practiced defense against recognition: intelligible evidence is covered, relabeled, and ranked beneath social pride, so additional information alone does not resolve it.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier sequence couples a spoken commitment with becoming straight. That pairing activates the focus collective not only as a group label but as a posture capable of either upright stability or the agitation supplied by ignorance.

activation_trace.role: Contributes uprightness and balance; here it remains latent inside the collective designation as a possible posture.
Contributes agitation after stillness; here it supplies the posture opposed to steady uprightness.
Contributes uttered speech; here it begins the alternative sequence in which saying is followed by stable alignment.
Contributes becoming straight and balanced; here it makes the alternative collective posture explicit.

structural_cues: 46:13 orders declaration before straight standing, whereas 46:23 orders the speaker's declaration before a collective characterized by ongoing ignorance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-to-straightness sequence and, in the focus, a speech-to-collective-ignorance sequence. I infer a contrast between two ways a community can settle after hearing speech. A live alternative is that the shared root produces only a lexical echo and that the focus collective noun carries no posture at all.

changed_reading.before: The collective designation fixes the addressees as an ignorant group.
changed_reading.after: The designation becomes dynamic: they are currently taking the agitated rather than upright collective posture, which leaves conceptual room for reorientation rather than making ignorance an essence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate demand treats truthfulness as the power to make a threatened event arrive on command. The focus answer restores the difference between knowing or controlling that arrival and delivering notice; the closing instruction to wait patiently and not hasten confirms that office boundary.

activation_trace.role: Contributes presence with a possessor; here it keeps decisive knowledge at the divine side of the agency boundary.
Contributes delivery of a message; here it states what the envoy can and must do instead of producing the event.
Contributes warning that should awaken caution; here it establishes the speech-act that precedes the audience's demand.
Contributes making or experiencing an arrival; here it frames the audience's imperative that the promised event be brought now.
Contributes a threatening promise; here it is the event whose production the audience wrongly assigns to the envoy.
Contributes fulfillment of word in action; here it shows why the audience equates immediate arrival with the speaker's truthfulness.
Contributes restraint from panic; here it supplies the proper temporal posture for a messenger who does not control arrival.
Contributes the class of commissioned carriers; here it generalizes the focus speaker's bounded office.
Contributes acceleration and premature advance; its prohibition here denies the envoy a mandate to force the timetable.
Contributes a promise bounded by time or place; here it keeps fulfillment on an appointed horizon rather than at audience demand.
Contributes remaining for a span; here it relativizes the experienced delay without transferring control of it to the envoy.
Contributes sufficient provision for need; here it lets the closing proclamation function as notice sufficient for responsibility.

structural_cues: 46:22 immediately precedes the focus and joins an imperative of arrival to a truthfulness test.
46:35 closes the surah by joining messenger patience, refusal to hasten, promised arrival, compressed delay, and sufficient proclamation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, a demand to bring the threat, a truthfulness test, patient messengers, non-hastening, an appointed promise, delay, and proclamation. I infer that the demand commits a category error by treating a carrier as controller and that the focus corrects it. A live alternative is that the demand is only taunting disbelief, while the final sufficiency branch may mean proclamation without a stronger legal sense of enough notice.

changed_reading.before: The speaker refuses the demand and says that he only conveys.
changed_reading.after: The reply diagnoses the demand's agency error: truthful messengerhood consists in sufficient notice, while knowledge, production, and timing of the promised event remain outside the messenger's office.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speaker's insight about the people is followed by their own literal sight of an approaching appearance. They fit it to the desired category of rain, but the correction identifies wind and punishment; later, intact sight is said not to have availed amid knowing denial.

activation_trace.role: Contributes considered judgment or opinion; here it makes the speaker's perception a diagnosis that can be tested by the next scene.
Contributes failure of knowledge or correct recognition; here it predicts the audience's coming category error.
Contributes literal sight; here it supplies sensory access that nevertheless fails to become correct recognition.
Contributes something appearing from a direction; here it supplies the ambiguous visible object onto which the audience projects a forecast.
Contributes water descending from cloud or sky; here it is the desired category the audience assigns to the appearance.
Contributes haste and premature advance; here it links their demand for acceleration to their premature visual conclusion.
Contributes moving air and wind; here it supplies the reality that reverses the rain interpretation.
Contributes eyesight; here its repeated possession confirms that the failure is not lack of sensory equipment.
Contributes denial in the presence of knowledge; here it explains why available faculties fail to yield acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 46:24 immediately follows the focus diagnosis and orders sight, confident rain classification, correction, and punishment.
46:26 inventories hearing, sight, and hearts before stating that they did not avail while signs were knowingly denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speaker's diagnosis, the audience's sight, an approaching appearance, their rain label, the wind correction, haste, intact faculties, and informed denial. I infer that the sequence stages ignorance as a concrete failure to convert perception into recognition. A live alternative is that the rain statement is ordinary hope under ambiguity and that only the narrator, not the focus diagnosis, supplies the irony.

changed_reading.before: The speaker generally judges the people ignorant.
changed_reading.after: The line forecasts a specific hermeneutic failure: they will see the arriving sign, force it into a desired rain-script, and demonstrate that sensory access can coexist with active nonrecognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later audience models the transformations missing from the focus audience: they understand hearing, attend in silence, remain present through completion, turn back, warn others, and call for a response. Delivery succeeds by generating new carriers rather than ending at exposure.

activation_trace.role: Contributes delivering a message; here it is the first link whose success the later reception sequence tests.
Contributes messenger and carried message; here it supplies a role that can be reproduced by receptive hearers.
Contributes hearing as understanding and compliance; here it begins reception as more than acoustic contact.
Contributes reading and recitation; here it supplies the transmissible content around which the hearers gather.
Contributes presence, proximity, and witnessing; here it marks sustained attendance to the recitation.
Contributes attentive silence; here it supplies the inhibition that lets reception continue without defensive interruption.
Contributes completion and coming to an end; here it marks that the hearers remain through the message's full course.
Contributes turning one's face toward a direction; here it pivots reception into return and onward address.
Contributes warning that awakens caution; here it shows hearers taking up the envoy's function for their own people.
Contributes a reply that answers speech; here it makes response the intended next stage after relay.
Contributes a verbal call that draws another; here it turns transmitted warning into an invitation demanding uptake.
Contributes answering speech; its negation here identifies failed uptake as the decisive contrast with the receptive relay.

structural_cues: 46:29 presents a strict sequence of hearing, attending, completion, turning back, and warning.
46:31-32 immediately polarize answering and not answering the transmitted call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered reception behaviors, return to another audience, renewed warning, a call, and the answer/non-answer contrast. I infer a causal relay in which successful hearing generates another carrier and in which the focus audience fails at uptake rather than exposure. A live alternative is that the later scene is only a narrative analogy and does not define the mechanics of the focus delivery verb.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's delivery is a one-way act that ends when the words reach the audience.
changed_reading.after: Delivery becomes the first stage of a reproducible relay: attentive recipients metabolize the message into warning and response, while the focus audience's ignorance names a break in that relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later report makes the baseline spatial analogy explicit: a receptive collective understands a descended written message that guides toward reality and an extended straight route. The same root occurrence links the addressed people with the route's straightness.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a distinguishing mark that guides; here it supplies the focus model's orienting landmark.
Contributes reaching a destination; here it lets communication be modeled as arrival on a navigable route.
Contributes terrain without reliable marks; here it names the disorientation opposed to the later straight route.
Contributes uprightness and straightness; the shared occurrence here links the addressed collective with alignment of the route.
Contributes understanding and compliance through hearing; here it is the receptive act that makes guidance usable.
Contributes ordered writing and a written object; here it gives the guide a stable vehicle.
Contributes causing something to descend and reach recipients; here it parallels the focus message's dispatched arrival.
Contributes gentle direction toward a path and truth; here it states the guide's route-setting function.
Contributes stable correspondence with reality; here it names the destination toward which the route guides.
Contributes an extended traversable way; here it makes the spatial mechanism overt rather than merely analogical.

structural_cues: 46:30 moves in one sentence from understood hearing and a descended written object to guidance, reality, and an extended straight route.
The authoritative occurrence record for 46:30 groups the address to the people and the route's straightness under the same root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a descended written guide, understood hearing, reality, a route, and shared collective/straightness morphology. I infer that the focus delivery carries an orienting landmark whose success is measured by navigation. A live alternative is that route language describes only the message's content and should not be projected onto the mechanics of delivery or the collective noun.

changed_reading.before: The wayfinding reading is only a focus-root analogy among marking, sending, reaching, and unknown terrain.
changed_reading.after: The later receptive report externalizes that analogy: delivered knowledge functions as a stable route-marker toward reality, and collective ignorance is failure to align with a path already made traversable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus morphology directly favors causing a message to be delivered, while 46:15 uses the same root for reaching two life-stage limits. It remains anchored in the focus delivery root and its endpoint branch, with an exact contextual recurrence and the focus rashness branch. Downstream prose should present it only as a faint developmental resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The delivery verb at word 6 can activate reaching an endpoint, while the ignorance verb at word 13 can activate rash immaturity.

activation_trace.role: Contributes reaching a limit or intended endpoint; here it opens a developmental echo beneath ordinary delivery.
Contributes arrival at successive limits; here the repeated maturity milestones activate the developmental scope of reaching.
Contributes rashness and lightness of judgment; here it supplies the immaturity exposed when arrival has not become grown discernment.

changed_reading.before: The envoy communicates the assigned message to the audience.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch field, delivery may also resonate with bringing hearers to a threshold of maturity, where their continued rashness shows that physical or temporal arrival has not become grown judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary collective sense of the focus noun is primary and the branch of an outwardly intact but sightless eye is lexically remote. It remains packet-anchored by that exact focus-root branch, the adjacent perception and ignorance roots, and 46:26's repeated eyesight made insufficient. Downstream prose should call it an activated image of functional blindness, not a lexical meaning of the collective noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collective noun at word 12 has a remote branch picturing an eye that remains physically standing after sight is gone, positioned between perception at word 11 and ignorance at word 13.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an eye whose visible structure remains while sight has departed; here it figures a socially intact but functionally blind collective.
Contributes sight by eye or insight; here it places the remote eye image inside an explicit perceptual frame.
Contributes failed recognition; here it specifies what is absent despite the appearance of perceptual capacity.
Contributes eyesight explicitly possessed; here its repetition supports the image of equipment present without effective seeing.
Contributes sufficiency or effective avail; its negation here turns possessed sight into functionally insufficient sight.

changed_reading.before: The speaker sees an ignorant social group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he sees a collective like an outwardly intact standing eye that cannot convert its available sight into recognition.

strongest_changes: The reply becomes a correction of agency: the audience demands event-production, while the envoy is responsible for sufficient delivery and not the timetable.
The next scene concretizes ignorance as perceptual misclassification: visible approach is confidently read as rain and is then reversed into destructive wind.
Earlier rejection patterns revise ignorance into socially motivated nonrecognition rather than lack of evidence.
The later attentive audience turns delivery into a reception relay that produces new warners and demands response.
Straight-path and shared collective morphology strengthen the focus-only model of delivered knowledge as an orienting landmark.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits at a narrative hinge where bounded messengerhood, observed ignorance, and literal seeing are immediately stress-tested. The packet preserves several coexisting mechanisms: office versus control, motivated refusal, failed visual inference, unstable collective posture, wayfinding, and successful relay. The odd maturity and standing-eye activations remain useful only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus perception verb can carry sensory seeing, reflective judgment, or both; the next ayah strengthens the overlap without fully resolving it.
The wayfinding and collective-posture models are coherent root activations, but their force beyond literary resonance remains uncertain.
The final sufficiency branch may indicate enough notice for responsibility or may simply name proclamation.
The maturation and standing-eye readings are deliberately branch-distant and should not control downstream synthesis.
